name: Camp Vega
description_short: An overnight summer camp for girls on Echo Lake in Fayette, Maine. It runs one full session of about seven weeks, with activities including sports, arts, waterfront and horseback riding.
refund_policy_summary: All payments are fully refunded up to 100 days before opening day, minus non-refundable costs such as credit card fees or chaperoned airline bookings. Within 100 days of opening or during camp, refunds exclude those costs and the $4,000 deposit, unless the reason is illness or injury. Refunds during camp are pro-rated.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp is on Echo Lake. Activities include swimming, sailing and watercraft, and waterskiing and wakeboarding. The page gives no details about lifeguards or swim tests.

source.title: Tuition & Dates - Girls Summer Camp on Echo Lake in Maine

warnings: Tuition doesn't include a $450 charge for personal, trip and outing expenses, or optional extras whose prices vary (equestrian, figure skating, chaperoned transportation, extended trips for grades 7–9).
Credit card payments have a 3% fee, except for the deposit and any payment made before September 1.
The page also lists Summer 2026 dates (June 27 – August 12, 2026), which are already past. Only the 2027 session is recorded.
